speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice)
question: How does cover spread, and time get made?
premises: Manifestation-named consciousness, sequenceless, from void-step, outside-merged — spreads utterly as covering.
Then too in inner-essence, by melted rush, sequencelessly — great Time-goddess, making all time (kalayantī emended; print kalayatāṃ fork live).
inference: Cover spread outside; time made within: Mahākālī.
uncertainties: kalayantī emendation with live fork (print anomalous).
